01567 Gal`ed {gal-e:d'}

源自 01530 和 05707; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Galeed 2; 2

迦累得 = "見證石堆"
1) 用來見證在雅各和拉班之間所立的約而堆起的石堆; 位於基列山
   (#創 31:47-48|)
record.edic_text:
01567 Gal`ed {gal-ade'}

from 01530 and 05707;; n pr loc

AV - Galeed 2; 2

Galeed = "witness heap"
1) the pile of stones heaped up between Jacob and Laban to certify
   their covenant; located on Mt Gilead
